claims.statement: Djoser’s reign is dated approximately 2649–2630 BCE in this chronology.
His Saqqara funerary complex included Egypt’s first pyramid.

evidence.note: Broad source-level context. This does not establish activity in every year or reconstruct political borders. Approximate period boundaries follow this source.
